acquisition method: MS data was acquired using a data-dependent top20 method dynamically choosing the most abundant precursor ions from the survey scan (350–1800 m/z) for HCD fragmentation.
alkylation reagent: then alkylated with iodoacetamide (200 mM IAA/100 mM NH4HCO3) in the dark at room temperature for 30 min.
alkylation concentration: then alkylated with iodoacetamide (200 mM IAA/100 mM NH4HCO3) in the dark at room temperature for 30 min.
cleavage agent: Gel pieces were digested overnight in 12.5 ng/μl trypsin in 25 mM NH4HCO3.
collision energy: Normalized collision energy was 27 and the isolation window was set to 1.5 Th.
enrichment method: immunoprecipitation coupled with mass spectrometry (IP-MS) was conducted to precipitate the immunolabeled protein(s) within the endostyle tissue lysates
fractionation method: Gel pieces were cut from SDS-PAGE, destained for 20 min in 100 mM NH4HCO3 with 30% Acetonitrile
fragmentation method: dynamically choosing the most abundant precursor ions from the survey scan (350–1800 m/z) for HCD fragmentation.
instrument: MS experiments were performed on a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer that was coupled to Easy nLC (Thermo Scientific).
labeling: The MS data were analyzed using MaxQuant software version 1.5.8.3.
reduction reagent: The in-gel proteins were reduced with dithiothreitol (10 mM DTT/ 100 mM NH4HCO3) for 30 min at 56 °C
reduction concentration: The in-gel proteins were reduced with dithiothreitol (10 mM DTT/ 100 mM NH4HCO3) for 30 min at 56 °C
